status: 나그네새 수백 마리 · 겨울철새 수백 마리 · 여름철새 수십 마리
summary: 우리나라 전 지역에서 번식하는 흔한 여름철새이며, 겨울에도 적은 수가 보인다. 숲, 트인 땅, 농경지 등지에 살며, 가는 줄기와 뿌리, 칡 따위로 밥그릇 모양 둥지를 짓고 엷은 푸른 바탕에 갈색 점이 있는 알을 3~6개 낳는다. 세계적으로는 중국, 일본, 동남아시아에 분포한다.

points.en: grey head and hindneck streaked black
black and chestnut bands across the breast

sexes.male: 머리에서 뒷목까지 회색에 검은 줄무늬가 있고, 가슴에 검은 띠와 밤색 띠가 또렷하다.
sexes.female: 전체적으로 색이 흐리고 가슴 띠도 또렷하지 않다.

art.subject: Chestnut-eared Bunting (Emberiza fucata), adult male in breeding plumage (April–August): crown and nape grey, finely streaked black; rich chestnut ear coverts forming a cheek patch; a narrow whitish eye-ring; white throat and submoustachial stripe bordered by a black malar stripe that runs down into a necklace of black streaks across the upper breast; below it a chestnut band across the lower breast; belly white, flanks washed rufous-buff; mantle brown streaked black; rump rufous-brown; wings brown with buff and rufous edges; tail dark brown with white outer feathers; bill dark grey above, pinkish below; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched on a stem at the edge of farmland, side view
art.scene: Korean summer farmland edge with open grassy ground and woodland behind; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view perched: black-streaked grey head and hindneck, rufous-chestnut ear coverts, white throat with a black malar stripe, a necklace of black streaks and a chestnut band across the breast, white belly, rufous-buff flanks
adult female, side view perched: browner, less grey head with duller chestnut ear coverts, weaker and less distinct breast bands, buffier underparts
art.build: Medium-sized bunting, slightly larger than a sparrow, slim, with a rounded head and a fairly long tail with white outer feathers. Bill small, conical and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish. Perches upright on grass stems, low shrubs and wires at field edges and feeds on the ground.
avoid: Do not paint a solid black breast band; the upper band is a necklace of black streaks, with a chestnut band below.
Do not paint an all-chestnut face with black crown stripes — that is Little Bunting (Emberiza pusilla).
Do not paint a white supercilium and a chestnut-brown body — that is Meadow Bunting (Emberiza cioides).
Do not paint any yellow on the underparts.
